difference_definition: 100 * (historical_BHSM - sandbox_reference) / sandbox_reference; not a statistical significance

rows.label: Muon / tau mass ratio
rows.explanation: Two heavier cousins of the electron: this ratio compares their masses without choosing a mass unit.

rows.label: Strong interaction strength
rows.explanation: The strong interaction binds quarks. Comparing its strength requires the same energy and measurement convention.

rows.label: Weak mixing parameter
rows.explanation: This number describes how the electromagnetic and weak descriptions mix. The report uses an MS-scheme reference.

rows.label: Electroweak scale
rows.explanation: A common scale enters the model’s mass formulas. A calibrated scale is not an independent prediction.

rows.label: Quark mixing |Vtd/Vts|
rows.explanation: Quarks change flavor through the weak interaction. This compares two mixing strengths.

rows.label: Neutrino mixing sin²θ12
rows.explanation: Neutrino flavors overlap. This is one of the three parameters describing that overlap.

rows.label: Neutrino mixing sin²θ13
rows.explanation: A second mixing parameter tests a different part of the same three-flavor pattern.

rows.label: Neutrino squared-mass gap ratio
rows.explanation: Oscillations probe differences between squared masses. Their ratio avoids an absolute mass scale.

rows.label: Neutrino mixing sin²θ23
rows.explanation: This is a visible tension with the supplied normal-ordering best-fit marker. The report notes broad allowed regions and octant ambiguity.

rows.label: Zeroth-order Higgs mass screen
rows.explanation: The simple mass screen sits below the supplied reference. It is not the completed, dressed physical mass.

qualitative_sentinels.text: Electron / tau: the supplied report records about +3.4%, but provides no underlying pair of numbers. No point is fabricated here.
Individual |Vtd| and |Vts| were reported about +4%; their ratio is closer. The source does not supply the individual values.
CKM gamma is reported near 64.6 degrees versus a mid-60-degree region; no artificial reference point or uncertainty is assigned.
CKM beta / sin(2 beta) has a reported low-side residual; the source does not give a complete numerical pair.
